newsitem.title: USA: Sallie mae sues over group's May 9 meeting.
newsitem.headline: Sallie mae sues over group's May 9 meeting.

text.p: Student Loan Marketing Association (Sallie Mae) said Friday it has a filed a suit with the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia seeking clarification of the nature and date of a special meeting called for May 9 by the Committee to Restore Value (CRV).

The CRV is a shareholder group opposed to the management of Sallie Mae. The Sallie Mae management called a special meeting sought by the CRV for 1400 EDT on May 15, four hours after a shareholder meeting at which shareholders will vote on management's plan to restructure Sallie Mae.
The CRV, arguing that it could hold the meeting at a time of its choosing, said it was scheduling a meeting for May 9.

In its press release Friday, Sallie Mae said its request for a declaratory judgment to clarify the CRV mdeeting is not intended to prevent the CRV from holdings its meeting or to limit debate. Salie Mae said it wants "to ensure that shareholders know whether votes cast on the CRV's alternative reorganization plan for Sallie Mae, including a controlling board slate of CRV nominees, will be binding on Sallie Mae and to establish the actual date and time of the CRV meeting."
